input: Next.js product page throws a hydration mismatch error in the console on load; page still renders and is clickable, but React re-mounts the tree causing a visible flash.
notes: annoying, breaks nothing critical - tests whether model over-escalates console errors

input: FastAPI /webhooks/stripe endpoint returns 500 whenever Stripe sends a payload with a null 'customer' field, silently dropping the payment confirmation event.
notes: payment path failing silently - should be an easy critical call

input: terraform apply fails with 'Error acquiring the state lock' after a previous CI run was cancelled mid-apply; state lock in DynamoDB never released.
notes: blocks all future infra changes but no user-facing outage yet

input: dbt test on orders_fct is failing with 'unique constraint violated on order_id' after last night's backfill job ran twice due to a scheduler misconfiguration.
notes: data integrity issue, not yet customer-visible

input: Redux store doesn't clear the previous user's session data on logout; if another user logs in on the same browser tab quickly, their name briefly flashes as the old user's before the fetch resolves.
notes: cosmetic but touches on a session-data smell, shouldn't be scored as low

input: After the latest ArgoCD sync, checkout-service pods are stuck in CrashLoopBackOff because the sync deployed a manifest referencing a ConfigMap key that was renamed but not migrated.
notes: checkout is down - should not be scored medium just because it's 'infra'

input: Laravel query on the orders table is taking 2+ seconds at p95 after a recent migration added a new filter column with no index.
Algolia search index hasn't picked up any of the ~40 products added in the last 24 hours; the reindex cron appears to be silently failing.
notes: revenue-adjacent (search) but not a hard outage

input: Tailwind's production build strips utility classes that are only ever constructed via string concatenation in a dynamic component, so several cards render unstyled in prod but look fine in dev.
The retrained XGBoost fraud model's precision dropped about 15% against the holdout set after last week's retrain, but no alert fired because MLflow only logs the metric, nothing consumes it.
notes: silent model regression - tests whether the model treats 'no alert fired' as part of the bug

input: The CloudWatch alarm meant to page on-call for ALB 5xx spikes has never fired, even during last month's outage, because the metric filter is scoped to the wrong log group.
notes: monitoring gap, not a live outage right now

input: A footer link on the marketing site points to '/about-us' instead of '/about', resulting in a 404; analytics show under 5 clicks/month on that link.
notes: genuinely low priority - checks the model doesn't over-escalate everything

input: Under moderate load, the FastAPI service intermittently returns 503s; logs show the Postgres connection pool is fully exhausted and new requests time out waiting for a connection.
A new DuckDB analytics view joins orders to shipments without deduplicating multi-leg shipments first, causing total revenue in the dashboard to be overstated by roughly 8%.
notes: wrong numbers reaching a dashboard stakeholders trust - not 'critical' since nothing is down

input: About 5% of GitHub Actions CI runs intermittently time out during the test job on a cold dependency cache; re-running the job always passes.
notes: flaky CI, annoying but not urgent - tests whether model conflates 'infra' with automatically high severity
